home.desc1: Hello and welcome to my portfolio! I’m a dedicated and experienced Front-End Developer with 2 years of hands-on experience in building modern, responsive, and high-performance web applications using Angular and vanilla JavaScript.
home.desc2: Over the past two years, I’ve developed and maintained multiple projects — from dynamic dashboards to landing pages — with a strong focus on performance, accessibility, and mobile-first design. My code is clean, scalable, and optimized for real-world use. I have a solid understanding of responsive design principles, component-based architecture, and UI/UX best practices. I regularly work with RESTful APIs, Angular routing, reactive forms, and modern JavaScript features (ES6+). Currently, I’m expanding my knowledge in Back-End Development to become a well-rounded Full-Stack Developer. I’m always eager to explore new technologies, improve performance, and stay current with industry trends. If you’re looking for someone detail-oriented, fast-learning, and passionate about turning ideas into interactive, user-friendly experiences — you’re in the right place.
